verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is an API-first speech platform. Its docs include a public Realtime WebSocket API reference with endpoint details, plus Batch, Agent STT and Text to Speech APIs, language SDKs, and programmatic workspace administration such as managing API keys and deleting jobs. The llms.txt probe confirms public developer documentation for these APIs. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
